dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: Have you been doing okay? Been busy? Are you hungry? Wanna come to my place for a bit?

dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: Ah, I... Sorry, I didn't mean to bother you...

dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: But you saved Grandpa, and that makes you our family's hero! Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: Ever since that incident, I've been thinking that I should work harder so I can help my Grandpa, just like you did!

dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: Miss Candace always says that I should be thankful to those who've helped me and that I should learn from them.

dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: But Dehya tells me that I should be patient 'cause I'm still young, and that I should start small and learn to live independently first before learning to take care of my Grandpa.

dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: And that's why I've started cooking for myself lately! I've practiced a few times, and I think it came out alright. Wanna try some?
